description: High Voltage Overhead Transmission Lines by Voltage Level (CKm) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset presents the total length of high voltage overhead transmission lines in circular kilometers (CKm), categorized by voltage levels (≥ 300 kV, 220 kV, 132 kV, 66 kV, 33 kV, and 11 kV). It includes both the lines in service and those commissioned annually. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are overhead, transmission, cables, high-voltage, grid. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
